l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.title: Nei x²−9y² ichigona kupatsanurwa asi x²+9y² isingagone?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.goal: Fungidzira kuti ndechipi chiyero (ruzivo) chinokosha kuti uone kana expression ichipatsanurwa seusiyano hwemasikweya maviri, uye utsanangure chikonzero chekusarudza kwako.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.material: x²−9y² inopatsanurwa kuita (x+3y)(x−3y). Asi x²+9y², inoratidzika yakafanana, haigoni kupatsanurwa nenzira imwe chete. Tsvaga chiyero chinoparadzanisa izvi zviviri.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.o.a: Kana iri muchimiro chemusiyano (kubvisa) wemasikweya maviri
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.b: x²+9y² ine materm maviri zvakare, asi haigoni kupatsanurwa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.c: Chiyero hachisi saini yemacoefficient asi kana iri muchimiro chekubvisa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange nemhando mbiri dzemavariable, huwandu hahugoni kupatsanurwa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.explain: A²−B²=(A+B)(A−B), saka inofanira kuva muchimiro chekubvisa. A²+B² haigoni kushandisa fomula iyi.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s2.model.0: x²−9y² ndiyo musiyano we x² ne(3y)², saka inoitwa zvinhu se(x+3y)(x−3y), asi x²+9y² ihuwandu, saka fomula iyi haigoni kushandiswa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s2.model.1: Fomula A²−B²=(A+B)(A−B) inoshanda pakubvisa chete, saka kuti ndiwo musiyano wemasikweya maviri ndiwo mutemo.
